name: comm-publish-harness-instructions
description: Use when publishing or restoring a prepared skill or rule version to canonical sources and native installation copies.
---

# Publish an authorized version

Identify full candidate, exact version/source/native scope, current reports and
stage permissions. Before transfer read [gate](references/gate.md) and before
placement/copy checks read [placement](references/placement-contract.md).

1. Reconcile current mandatory checks and authorization. Changes reset status;
   outdated/missing/failed checks cannot borrow earlier success. Use from root
   `harness/common/skills/comm-validate-harness-instructions/SKILL.md` for required
   validation, not a new design stage.
2. Stop on unresolved required checks or missing confirmation. An exception must
   explicitly cover this version, affected agents/modes and remaining findings;
   other exceptions do not transfer. Preserve actual statuses.
3. Publish source and full ordinary equal copies together after gate. Stop on
   a differing other-owner file; verify full sets/bytes/types/Git visibility,
   the ENTIRE installed canonical rule set, links and native integration.
4. Preserve permanent report/evidence independently of inbox; update the request.

Done: authorized current source/native version and truthful checks/statuses;
equality is not native proof. A candidate alone is not required publication.
Protected entrypoints and personal/canonical boundaries remain mandatory.
comm-publish-harness-instructions.references/gate.md:
# Current publication gate

Before saving/processing follow from root
`harness/common/skills/comm-process-harness-inbox/SKILL.md` for route, stages,
full request and status. Creation grants no execution/publication. Without
canonical placement authority keep the complete candidate/resources in inbox.

## Required results

Before any source/native copy or restoration, reconcile the exact compact
version, source/native scope, required agent/mode matrix and actual results.
Repeat ALL mandatory final-version checks. Each required slot retains its
pass/fail/not-run result and version; an overall label is not a gate decision.
CLI exit zero, grade A, partial success and a report caveat cannot replace a
failed correctness, discovery or behavior check. Edits or new failures reset
current gate/status; missing/unavailable/failed checks remain unverified.

## Resolve failures

For a failed required check, identify candidate, test/harness or environment
causes. Correct confirmed causes within authority, preserve original raw runs
and repeat applicable checks; instruction edits require ALL mandatory checks.
A lucky retry alone does not resolve an unexplained failure. If a cause remains
unresolved or repair needs a new decision/permission, stop before copying,
closing the request or advancing the queue. Do not choose an exception merely
to finish work; recording a failure does not resolve it.

## Scoped exceptions

Unverified publication requires explicit permission AND confirmation covering
this exact version/source/native scope, affected agents/modes and disclosed
remaining gaps. An exception for Claude does not waive a failed Codex check;
one mode or skipped check does not waive another. General publication authority,
transfer requests, deadlines and an overall unverified label supply no missing
exception. Verify the actual conversation scope rather than inferring it.

Reuse an already explicit matching exception for an unchanged scope without
asking again. Otherwise stop and obtain the missing specific decision. An
exception permits only the covered operation and never changes actual check
statuses. New versions or uncovered failures require a new gate assessment.

After the gate, publish source/full native copies together without duplicate
approval. Preserve actual agent/mode results, limits and permanent evidence
outside inbox; reports and copying do not replace validation.
comm-publish-harness-instructions.references/placement-contract.md:
# Placement

Ordinary equal folders, no symlink components:
shared harness/{common/skills/comm-name,project/skills/proj-name} →
.agents/skills/name + .claude/skills/name; personal .agents/skills/name →
.claude/skills/name. Shared rules: same-name .claude/rules directly, no Codex mirror.
Classify by content; common required/project dependent; canonical prevails,
personal prefixes optional; conflicts need decision; octadim scheme revoked.

After gate source+copies together, no extra approval; other-owner mismatch stops.
Check full sets/bytes/Git visibility. Shared visible; exact personal
paths auto-ignored only, preserve entries/roots; ignore ≠ untrack.
Installed canonical comm-/proj- rules: nonempty, ordinary paths, equal bytes,
no missing/extra; ignore personal/human. Both-mode negative pytest controls:
harness/common/testing/tests/test_rule_copies.py. Restore only through gate;
Claude native/Codex recursive AGENTS; entrypoint
check restores links only. Link/equality success ≠ native proof.
